name: nuScenes: Multimodal Autonomous Driving Dataset
description: A public benchmark dataset for autonomous driving developed by Motional (formerly nuTonomy). Collected in Boston and Singapore across dense urban traffic, night conditions, and rain. Consists of 1,000 driving scenes of 20 seconds each, captured with a synchronized sensor suite including 6 surround cameras, 1 rotating 32-beam roof LiDAR, 5 long-range radar sensors, and accurate GPS/IMU navigation. Features 1.4 million 3D bounding box annotations across 23 object classes with full velocity attributes and attributes for tracking and prediction.
